metadata.title: fix: plugin runtime defaults and tag normalization
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary
- allow overriding external plugin runtime with MCP_PYTHON
- clear the plugin registry before re-init to avoid stale entries
- normalize resource/service tags to string lists and align schema

commits.message:
fix: plugin runtime defaults and tag normalization

- allow overriding the python runtime for external plugins
- reset plugin registry before re-init to avoid stale entries
- normalize resource/service tag lists to strings

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti
